titre: La facture mondiale du calcul IA
sous_titre: Chiffre d'affaires trimestriel des puces pour data centers, en Mds $, d'octobre 2025 à juillet 2026

oct. 2025.texte: Third-quarter revenue was a record $51.2 billion, up 25% from the previous quarter and up 66% from a year ago.

janv. 2026.texte: Record quarterly Data Center revenue of $62.3 billion, up 22% from the previous quarter and up 75% from a year ago

avr. 2026.texte: Record Data Center revenue of $75.2 billion, up 92% from a year ago

juil. 2026.texte: Data Center revenue of $89.0 billion, up 117% from a year ago
